what: Proposed `stat_mtime` tries BSD `stat -f '%m'` before GNU `stat -c '%Y'` with only a non-empty check
scenario_or_breakage: On Linux (CI / primary harness lane), GNU `stat -f` enters filesystem-info mode and can emit non-numeric stdout; `list_cached_versions_by_mtime` then ranks cache dirs incorrectly or unpredictably (see `skills/implement/scripts/lib-resolve-implement-tmpdir.sh:73-83`)
suggested_fix: Mirror repo convention: GNU first, then BSD, require `^[0-9]+$` before accepting output (as in `scripts/check-reviewers.sh:93-97`)
